description:
Piracy Reworked
v0.2.0 - the underworld runs on your money - for Starsector 0.98a-RC8

Download

PiracyReworked-0.2.0.zip

Extract into your Starsector mods/ folder and enable it in the launcher. Safe to add to an existing save.

Description

Basically i didnt like how pirate bases were random and infinite, in that no matter how many you destroy another pops up. I also dont like how the core early game loop of starsector is to buy and sell exclusively on the black market with near zero consequences. So in a nutshell the core concept is the more black market stuff you do the richer the pirates get and the more bases they can afford, which leads to them snowballing with more raids, more profits from raids -> more bases again etc etc. Obviously you can keep them under control by wiping out their bases, so you offset your ledger so to speak. Selling weapons has a higher modifier than say supplies, so its weighted based on what you are doing.

There's a bunch of other features but this is the gist of it. Once the pirates get wealthy enough the 'Piracy Respite' earned from defeating the colony crisis wont be enough to stop them messing with your shipping, and they will wreak havoc on the stability of the core worlds. There is also a debt collection system for black market activity you do with transpponder on; the port authorities wil try to collect debt equal to unpaid tarrifs. its off by default as still not sure if it actually makes for enjoyable gameplay.

Recommended mod collection for ultimate late game experience

Standalone, safe to add mid-save, can be run together or separately.

Threat Incursion — the threat colonizes the sector and invades the core worlds. Disrupt their supply chains and besiege the entrenched hives into decline.
Commerce Wars — dominate a faction's markets or the military balance and they push back: ultimatums, tribute, enforcement fleets.
Piracy Reworked — the underworld runs on your money: black-market trade funds a self-sustaining pirate war economy.
Remnant Retribution — a late-game colony crisis.
Useful Planetary Shield — planetary shields finally do something: they absorb orbital bombardment.

Disclaimer: This post and mod were written using Claude's Fable AI model.
